days.note: A short drive from Guptkashi to Sonprayag and Gaurikund, then the pilgrim path up the Mandakini to Kedarnath, the first of the five
Darshan at Kedarnath, and the short climb to Bhukund Bhairavnath temple above it
Down to Gaurikund, then by road through Guptkashi and Ukhimath to Ransi
Down to the Madhmaheshwar Ganga and along it to Gaundar village
Up through Bantoli and Nanu to the meadow temple facing Chaukhamba, the second of the five
A morning at Budha Madhmaheshwar on the meadow above
All the way down to Ransi, then by road over to Chopta
Up to Tungnath, the third and highest of the five, and on to Chandrashila; back down to Chopta and by road through Mandal to Sagar
From Sagar up through oak forest and the Lyuti meadows to Panar bugyal
Over Pitradhar to Rudranath, the fourth of the five, a rock shrine high on the meadows
The old way down from Rudranath through forest and over ridges to Dumak village
Up to the old Vishnu temple at Bansi Narayan
Down to Kalpeshwar, the fifth of the five, then through the Urgam valley and by road to Helang on the Badrinath highway
